title: OMR-NorthStar Split Manifest
description: Canonical full split manifest envelope for OMR-NorthStar (OMR-NS) benchmark releases (dev-v1, test-v1, fresh-YYYY).

manifest_version.description: Optional semantic version of the manifest pack (e.g., 0.1.0).

benchmark_version.description: Semantic version of the benchmark release (e.g., 1.0.0).

split.description: Split identifier for all pages contained in this manifest.

canary.description: Anti-contamination canary string (required on dev splits, e.g., OMR_NS_V1_CANARY_DO_NOT_TRAIN).

track.description: Manifest licensing track: core_permissive or research_nc_eval_only (evaluation-only NC track, strictly forbidden for training).

eval_only.description: Must be true on research_nc_eval_only track (strictly forbidden for training).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of manifest generation.

license.description: Optional top-level SPDX license identifier for the manifest pack.

ground_truth_files.description: Optional mapping from page_id to relative ground-truth file path.

visual_severity_scale.description: Supported visual severity levels (V1-V4) used across manifest pages.

phenomena_vocabulary.description: Optional list of canonical phenomena_tags tracked in this split.

pages.description: Ordered list of per-page metadata records.
